prompt:
A wide establishing vista of the Iron Nation — the land of the element Iron (Fe) — in a high-fantasy world: environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: a fantasy kingdom of smiths: a mountain fortress built around a great forge, rivers of molten iron glowing in channels, hammered-iron gates, anvils as altars, iron filings drawn into patterns by magic magnetism, ember sparks in the air.

Places to fold into the view: inside the great forge: anvils, hammers hung on the wall, a river of molten iron glowing in a channel; before the hammered-iron fortress gate on the mountainside, ember sparks drifting in the air; a magnetite mine shaft where iron filings hang in the air in magnetic patterns.

The element's character, as light hints in the land's materials, light and air: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy.

Colour key: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the land spread across the middle ground, the far distance and sky behind. The whole land reads at a glance as one memorable silhouette. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (ground, water or haze without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching a Japanese anime key visual — a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth; luminous, rich colours, crisp focal details and softer painted edges toward the distance.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Avoid: modern material, machinery.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
